bearerAuth.description: After login, enter data.accessToken in the Swagger Authorize dialog. Enter only the token; Swagger adds the Bearer prefix. Submit refreshToken only in refresh or logout request bodies.

info.description:
REST API for user management, ticket categories, assignments, status transitions, and comments.

Log in at `POST /api/auth/login` and enter `data.accessToken` in **Authorize** to access protected endpoints.

JSON responses use a common envelope with `code`, `message`, and `data` or `errors`. Paginated lists accept `page` and `pageSize` (default 20, maximum 100).

See each endpoint for permissions, validation rules, and error codes.

post.description: Public endpoint; no access token is required. Valid credentials return user details and an access/refresh token pair. Usernames contain 3-32 lowercase letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens; passwords contain 8-128 characters. Unknown usernames and incorrect passwords both return AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS. Defaults: 5 consecutive failures lock an account for 900 seconds; 20 failures from one IP within 900 seconds trigger throttling. Limits are configurable and block subsequent attempts after the threshold is reached. A successful login clears the account failure count; IP failures remain until the window expires.
